query_original: What is Parc Fermé and when does it apply?
query_reformulada: What are the definitions and application periods for Parc Fermé as per Article 22.2 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations?
resposta:
What is Parc Fermé and when does it apply?

Parc Fermé refers to a designated secure area at a Competition where F1 Cars must be kept after qualifying and during certain other periods of the Competition. It applies from the time each F1 Car is deemed to be in parc fermé, which starts immediately (Article 5.1).
